description: Finish a consent from the URL the approval redirected to (http://localhost:...?state=...&code=...). The grant is checked (the right account, every scope ticked, a refresh token) and saved where the product reads it, and the product uses it from the next call. Returns what was granted, never a token.

redirect_url.description: The whole URL from the browser's address bar.
